items.title: Goldman Sachs’ economic outlook for 2027
items.summary: Investing.com -- Goldman Sachs expects global real gross domestic product growth of 2.8% in 2027, slightly above their estimate of 2.7% in 2026 but with risks titled to the downside. According to the brokerage, tighter financial conditions and more neutral fiscal policy have been offset by lower energy prices and still-strong artificial intelligence capital expenditure.

items.title: Goldman Traders See Entry Point in US Stocks But Warn of Risks
items.summary: Goldman Sachs Group Inc.’s trading desk says last week’s selloff has created an attractive opportunity to snap up US stocks. Still, the bank cautions that overall investor positioning remains elevated, signaling the broader capitulation needed for a meaningful rally could be missing.

Goldman Sachs and Apollo structured the deal to fund high-end chips and related hardware used in SpaceX's AI and space-related systems.
